sources.name: MLB Stats API
limitations: live stats change constantly; use for identity, not a season snapshot
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-09-15: /api/v1/teams?sportId=1 returned the 30 current franchises.

sources.name: MLB.com
limitations: some pages reject automated fetches (HTTP 403); prefer the Stats API for structured reads

sources.name: Official Baseball Rules (2026 Edition)
sources.publisher: Office of the Commissioner of Baseball
limitations: PDF; store rule number, name and a structured summary, never the full text
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-09-15. 192 pages, rules 1.00-9.00 plus Definitions of Terms and Appendices.

sources.name: MLB Glossary
limitations: the HTML endpoint returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches; definitions are curated from official terminology and cross-checked with the rulebook

sources.name: Baseball Savant (Statcast)
limitations: metric definitions live partly in page copy; availability depends on tracking-era coverage (2015+)
sources.notes: Official Statcast data and metric definitions.

sources.name: MLB Pipeline
limitations: rankings are editorial and change often

sources.name: MLB Transactions
limitations: live feed; never persist as long-term knowledge

sources.name: National Baseball Hall of Fame
sources.publisher: National Baseball Hall of Fame and Museum
limitations: election rules may change between cycles; verify the current cycle
sources.notes: Official Hall of Fame source for eligibility and election thresholds.

sources.name: Major League Baseball Players Association
limitations: the full CBA text is not always published at a stable public endpoint
